jobs.description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell. Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow.
